scenarios.situation: Client reports an existing model and comparison evidence.
scenarios.assessment_focus: Clarify whether the existing capability covers the intended use and deployment boundary.
scenarios.next_question: Which exact operating range and reference comparisons are permitted for a bounded applicability review?
scenarios.stop_condition: Stop after the intended-use and reference-access gaps are explicitly recorded.

scenarios.situation: Client has an objective but reference adequacy and access remain unresolved.
scenarios.assessment_focus: Keep the supported-family hypothesis separate from reference feasibility.
scenarios.next_question: Can a source owner identify one permitted reference-feasibility check for this exact proposed scope?
scenarios.stop_condition: Stop without numerical execution when reference identity, rights, or allowance is absent.

scenarios.situation: Synthetic coupled-physics request has no supported authoring route.
scenarios.assessment_focus: Define one bounded physical-definition compatibility question.
scenarios.next_question: Can the accepted core capability interface represent the requested coupled observable without changing its meaning?
scenarios.stop_condition: Stop after one compatibility finding or a precise unsupported result.

scenarios.situation: Client states an objective but leaves outputs, conditions, reference, rights, and performance requirements unknown.
scenarios.assessment_focus: Preserve unknowns and ask for the single clarification that changes feasibility scope.
scenarios.next_question: Which engineering decision and observable must the first pilot inform?
scenarios.stop_condition: Stop after the client identifies one observable or confirms it remains unknown.
